stemMd: An object’s speed triples while its mass stays constant. By what factor does its kinetic energy change?
explanationMd: Kinetic energy is one half mv². With fixed mass, replacing v by 3v multiplies v² by nine. The constant one half cancels when taking the ratio of final to initial energy.

distractorRationale.b: Kinetic energy depends on speed squared, not speed alone.
distractorRationale.c: This incorrectly combines the factor one half with the speed multiplier.
distractorRationale.a: Increasing speed does not reduce kinetic energy.
distractorRationale.e: This would require a cubic dependence on speed.
